method.source: Entire UTF-8 files including comments and final newline, without Markdown fences.
method.wall_ms: Elapsed spawn through exit of a fresh process, including interpreter startup.
method.cpu_ms: OS wait4 user plus system CPU time.
method.peak_rss_mib: OS wait4 per-process maximum resident set size in MiB.
method.compile_run: Translate and execute the source on every invocation. OS caches may be warm.
method.cached_python: Compile once before timing, then invoke the generated Python as a script.
method.python_helpers: Python syntax with the compact language's implicit helpers. Count the authored .helper.py, expand its prelude before timing, then execute the expanded script.
method.order: Modes interleaved within each round, rotated and shuffled in seeded blocks.
method.scale_factor: Each full seed sequence is repeated in order. CSV keeps one header. Goldens preserve group means and most frequent word, multiply counts, and repeat each stable score tie group in order.
method.correctness: Every warmup and measured run must match the expected stdout bytes and exit zero.
